U.S. AIR FORCE - AFSCS

Air Force ASVAB Scores

Minimum AFQT, how mage scores work, and the score needed for every entry-level AFSC

Minimum AFQT: 31

The Air Force accepts an AFQT of 31 or higher for applicants with a high school diploma. Its official baseline is 36, with 31 allowed at the recruiting service's discretion, so a higher score gives you more room.

How the Air Force Scores Jobs

The Air Force (and Space Force) combines your section scores into four MAGE scores: Mechanical, Administrative, General, and Electrical. Each is reported as a percentile from 1 to 99, and each job (AFSC) sets a minimum on one or more of them.

CodeScoreMade from
MMechanicalAR + MC + AS + 2 x VE
AAdministrativeMK + VE
GGeneralAR + VE
EElectricalGS + AR + MK + EI

MAGE scores are percentiles: a G of 55 means you scored as well as or better than 55 percent of the reference group. Some jobs also use the TAPAS personality test or the Predictive Success Model (PSM), which are given separately.
